payload.title: 导入现有架构
payload.goal: 将 130 个源文件导入为可审阅的 L0/L1 架构。批准前请审阅模块边界与职责。

acceptance: 每个 L0 模块都有可识别的职责
L1 单元映射到真实文件

nodeIntents.statement: One-hop non-containment relationships, including edges removed by a diff.
Searchable remote model picker that always accepts a custom model id.
A small, self-contained architecture fixture for the canvas. It is only a renderer-side demo: it never claims to be a project, never writes a WAL, and cannot start an approval or implementation turn.
L1 units directly below an L0 module, or facts below an L1 unit.
Shiki is loaded lazily by the renderer. The cache is deliberately small: source files can be large, and stale file contents are not worth retaining.
Set the interface language and notify every subscribed component.
Localized approval-risk copy. Unknown future hints keep their stored text.
L0 modules whose L1 units are currently revealed.

Virtual file system used by the Eko tool loop. Eko may read real files, but every write/delete is staged in memory until the run finishes. The session then applies the staged edits through its existing atomic writer, after the run has been cancelled, audited o
Apply a prevalidated file batch and restore its committed prefix on failure.

Serialize the approved architecture for the planner. `budgetChars` is derived from the configured context window and compaction ratio. L0 is kept first because it anchors IDs; L1 and facets are then compressed until the budget is exhausted.

Deterministic planner used when no AI provider is configured, and as a fallback when the provider returns unusable JSON. It only handles simple, explicit structural verbs; everything else becomes an intent-only version rather than pretending an LLM wrote a pla
Common model families that accept a reasoning-effort control.
Turn a planner's loose ids and patches into legal WAL ops. LLM output is untrusted: every id, parent, kind, and optimistic-concurrency hash is checked here, before the user sees the proposal.
One file section of a unified diff, normalized to a project-relative path.

Normalize a project-relative path and reject anything that could escape the workspace or touch Jin/Git/toolchain internals. Every staging layer and the final writer use this rule, so a generated edit can never become a write the approval-bound coder would refu
A turn is either a direct conversational reply or an architecture proposal.
Best-effort token telemetry from the provider response.

Validate a shell command before it reaches the OS. This is a guardrail, not an OS sandbox: commands may only use project-relative paths, and obviously destructive commands are rejected. Every attempt is audited.
Compare two snapshots. Only direct node/edge changes live in `nodes`/`edges`; `colors` additionally contains the ancestors and edge endpoints that should be tinted in the architecture graph.
Apply proposed ops to a clone without touching the approved snapshot.
Semantic snapshot hash. Timestamps and touch bookkeeping are excluded so a touch-only version has the same base and target; the reviewed change set is bound separately with `diffHash`.
Application-level data lives in Electron userData, never in the project. The caller supplies the path so this module is testable without Electron.
The project-local materialized index. It owns no authority: if deleted, the next `rebuildFromWal` recreates it.
Open the disposable project index. Everything in it can be rebuilt from `.jin/wal.jsonl`; it is never the source of truth.
Build a read-only project tree. Hidden project files are included except caches.

Resolve the driver used by Git. Installed apps ship a self-contained `merge-wal.cjs` next to the main bundle and run it through Electron's Node mode, so teammates do not need Node.js or a Jin source checkout.
List local branches and remote-tracking branches without changing the tree.
Deterministic JSON for hashing. Object keys are sorted; array order is preserved; `undefined` object fields are omitted and `undefined` array items become `null` (matching JSON.stringify).

Derive a stable 26-character Crockford id from a seed. The first character is fixed to `0`, which keeps the value inside the canonical ULID alphabet and avoids pretending this is a sortable timestamp. Architecture node/edge ids must survive a rescan, so they a
Generate a canonical 26-character Crockford base32 ULID.
1-based and present only when the language server returned a source range.
System plus Marketplace specs; defaults to the built-in PATH specs.
Marketplace installs carry their own display metadata.
LSP facts are disposable observations. They live beside the WAL-derived index in `.jin/cache/index.db` and are rewritten after each scan.
Unix mode including the file-type bits, for example 0o100755.

Extract a VSIX (a plain ZIP) without external tools. Symlink entries are rejected, paths are confined to `destination`, and both per-file and total sizes are capped. Jin only extracts user-selected VS Code extensions, but a marketplace download is still untrus
MCP manager. Configured servers are connected lazily for a tools snapshot; enabling a server never opens an approval dialog. Every refresh is audited in `.jin/cache/mcp-audit.jsonl`.
Intent creation → first approval. A non-monotonic clock is ignored, not guessed.

Local provider usage ledger. It is deliberately a disposable cache: tokens and costs are operational telemetry, not part of the architecture ledger, so deleting `.jin/cache/usage.json` only resets the dashboard.
Walk up from `start` looking for `.jin` (initialized) or `.git` (repo root). An uninitialized repo is still a valid location; the UI can offer `jin init`.
Initialize `.jin/` idempotently. `force` refreshes config but never truncates the WAL or deletes the cache: history is the one thing init must not destroy.
Durable, disposable RAG cache: document text, architecture metadata, dense vectors and a custom-token FTS5 shadow table. Every row is derived from the repo and can be rebuilt by the next scan.
Calculate invoice totals, tax, and line item amounts.

Lightweight code reuse retrieval. It combines a BM25-like keyword score, a deterministic feature-hashed dense vector, an FTS5 candidate prefilter and one-hop architecture graph expansion. The in-memory view is a cache; `RagStore` mirrors it into `.jin/cache` s
New content keyed by path, used to find exports that duplicate an existing unit.
Latin words plus individual CJK characters and CJK bigrams. The bigrams are what make Chinese retrieval work without a dictionary tokenizer, both in memory and in the FTS5 shadow table.
Give imported architecture nodes their source-derived purpose, separate from the scan task.
Read the previous scan manifest. A missing or corrupt cache is a cold scan, not an error.
Parsed facts cached by file mtime + size; LSP members are merged every scan.
Normalize a project-relative path without accepting absolute/escaping paths.
Shared app-level VS Code Marketplace store, when available.

Global settings live in Electron userData. The API key is never exposed to the renderer: `get()` reports only whether one exists, and the agent reads it through `getProviderApiKey()` in the main process.
User-level skill roots shared by Jin, agents, and cc-switch.

A small hybrid logical clock. Wall time gives rough ordering; the counter preserves monotonicity within a process; the actor id is the deterministic tie-breaker. The serialized form is `0000019a2b3c4d:0001:user:joshua`.
Minimal surface of electron-updater used by Jin.

Check that the approved structural target is actually present in a fresh scan. Structural edges are accepted as declared metadata; node existence and file/symbol presence are checked against source facts.

Fold WAL records into the current architecture snapshot. Only approved/implemented/verified versions mutate nodes and edges. Draft and rejected versions remain in history. Each version is applied atomically to a clone; a stale write or a mismatched approval le
Return the current causal frontier. A linear log has one head; a merged log can have several. New records should name every head as a parent so no branch is accidentally orphaned.
Parse a JSONL WAL, collecting per-line errors instead of failing the file.
A conflicted version reconstructed from its own WAL ancestry.

Merge three record sets (Git base/ours/theirs). The result is a deterministic union in causal order. Semantic write conflicts are reported but the union is still valid; the app turns them into a merge intent.
Topologically order records by `parents`, breaking ties with HLC then id. Duplicate ids with identical hashes are deduplicated; conflicting duplicates, missing parents, and cycles are reported.
Hash a record without its `hash` field. Parents are canonicalized.

Reconstruct one version for read-only history. The base snapshot is the fold of the intent record's causal ancestors. The reviewed target is rebuilt by applying that version's ops, intent and touches to a clone of the base, so a rejected or conflicted version
The built directory structure ```tree ├─┬─┬ dist │ │ └── index.html │ │ │ ├─┬ dist-electron │ │ ├── main.js │ │ └── preload.js │ ```
Headless packaged smoke used by CI: verify the renderer and preload load.
Conformance results written before `kind` existed identify drift by evidence.
One semantic node change. `before`/`after` are the reviewed snapshots, not the live snapshot, so the UI can render a proposal even after local edits.

Architecture model shared by the Electron main process and the renderer. The model is intentionally boring: nodes are stable identities, files and symbols are attributes, and every change is expressed as an op. The current snapshot is a fold of approved WAL re

Conservative branch-name gate shared by the Git service and the renderer. Git accepts more characters than this, but rejecting whitespace, control characters, `..`, `@{`, and leading `-` keeps names safe as argv entries and portable across Windows/macOS checko

Shared English/Chinese copy for the renderer, the Electron menu, and the main-process session messages. Values may contain `{name}` placeholders. A value with a `|` separator has singular/plural forms selected by the numeric `count` parameter.
Reasoning effort forwarded to OpenAI-compatible providers.
The minimum provider shape needed to decide whether Jin can call a model.
WAL record types. A record is content-addressed. `parents` describe causal ancestry and are the only thing that makes two independently appended log files mergeable.
